CULLING audit 2026-09-27 (observed Oblivion behavior): Geometry submission boundary reached by 0x7227A0. With +0x08 array: +0x04 UseAppendVirtual selects vtable+0x0C, otherwise append to {data +0,size +4,capacity +8,growBy +0xC}. Without array: accumulator+0x58 registers geometry; absent accumulator or false low-byte result invokes geometry Render(+0x84). CULLING's rendererForwards observes entry handoffs, not this branch outcome or GPU draws.

Culling.dll decode: NiCullingProcess::OnVisible. With VisibleGeo, appends NiGeometry into the visible array; without VisibleGeo, queues to the active accumulator slot +0x58 or renders directly as fallback.

DX11 GPU-world migration 2026-09-27, observed in OblivionNew: VisibleGeo nonnull uses AppendVirtual when the flag is set, otherwise grows/appends the geometry pointer array. With no VisibleGeo, accumulator vfunc+58 may accept the geometry; absent accumulator or false low-byte result calls geometry Render immediately. A GPU submission replacement must preserve these routes and opaque EAX behavior; merely omitting OnVisible is not a complete scene-semantics implementation.
